name: Fsr3UpscalerExecute
signature: void Fsr3UpscalerExecute(void* p1, Gfx* g, Fsr3Inputs* in)
description: Per-frame FSR3 path: Fsr3EnsureContext, GENERATE_REACTIVE (0x10006, when RS+0x1ff8==2), upscale dispatch 0x10001, FG prepare 0x20004 (only if FG ctx+FI swapchain exist), upscaled-depth copy to 0x45c4328, FSR3VelocityViewportFix (render ratio != 1 only); callers PostEffectApply 0x6da118, FSR FG backend 0x34692bc

name: Fsr3Execute_ReactiveModeGate
description: cmp dword [rbp+0x2868],2 / jnz: RS+0x1ff8 reactive mode; 2 = generate reactive mask from opaque copy and use it as the reactive input

name: Fsr3Execute_DispatchGenReactive
description: call ffxDispatch(ctx 0x45c4300, desc type 0x10006); out = 0x45c4318

name: Fsr3Execute_ReactiveSlotSelect
description: upscale desc reactive = (RS+0x1ff8==2) ? 0x45c4318 : null; T&C always null

name: Fsr3Execute_DispatchUpscale
description: call ffxDispatch(ctx 0x45c4300, desc type 0x10001 at rbp+0x180); public ffx-api layout + 1 extra resource (depth, COMPUTE_READ) before output + 9-dword tail after flags (custom fork)

name: Fsr3Execute_FgPrepareGate
description: skips FG prepare (0x20004) / UI register (0x30002) / interpolation queries unless 0x47092b0 and 0x47092b8 are both non-null

name: Fsr3EnsureContext
signature: void Fsr3EnsureContext(void* state, Gfx* g, PostFrameState* pfs, Fsr3CtxParams* p)
description: Creates FSR3 upscale ctx (flags DEPTH_INVERTED | AUTO_EXPOSURE if RS+0x2000) and FG ctx when FI swapchain exists; re-creates only when sizes, RS+0x1ffe, auto-exposure, FG mode RS+0x2058, FI swapchain ptr, HDR or p+9 change; allocates 0x45c4310/18/20/28/38

name: Fsr3DestroyContext
description: Destroys FG ctx 0x47092b0 + upscale ctx 0x45c4300, unregisters UI resource, frees FSR3 textures; callers PostEffectApply, 0x346c424, Fsr3EnsureContext

name: Fsr3SaveOpaqueColor
signature: void Fsr3SaveOpaqueColor(void* p1, Gfx* g, PostFrameState* pfs)
description: Mid-frame CopyRect of scene color into 0x45c4310 (GP2 FSR3:SaveOpaqueColor) for GENERATE_REACTIVE; caller 0x19481ee

name: ffxDispatch
signature: ffxReturnCode_t ffxDispatch(ffxContext* ctx, const ffxDispatchDescHeader* desc)
description: AMD ffx-api loader entry (exe export ordinal 111), statically linked

name: ffxConfigure
signature: ffxReturnCode_t ffxConfigure(ffxContext* ctx, const ffxConfigureDescHeader* desc)
description: AMD ffx-api loader entry (export ord 108)

name: ffxCreateContext
signature: ffxReturnCode_t ffxCreateContext(ffxContext* ctx, ffxCreateContextDescHeader* desc, const ffxAllocationCallbacks* mem)
description: AMD ffx-api loader entry; called by Fsr3EnsureContext

name: ffxQuery
description: AMD ffx-api loader entry; FSR3 path queries 0x10010001 (internal resource 0x33 = upscaled depth source)

name: ffxDestroyContext
signature: ffxReturnCode_t ffxDestroyContext(ffxContext* ctx, const ffxAllocationCallbacks* mem)
description: AMD ffx-api destroy; called by Fsr3DestroyContext

name: g_Fsr3CtxCreated
description: 1 after Fsr3EnsureContext created the context; followed by cached recreate keys 0x45c4171..0x45c4181

name: g_Fsr3CreateDesc
description: type 0x10000; flags at 0x45c4198 (8 | 0x20 auto-exposure), maxRender 0x45c419c, maxUpscale 0x45c41a4

name: g_Fsr3UpscaleCtx
description: FSR3 upscaler ffx context

name: g_Fsr3OpaqueColorCopy
description: render-size opaque-only color copy (GENERATE_REACTIVE input)

name: g_Fsr3GeneratedReactive
description: render-size generated reactive mask; the upscale reactive input when RS+0x1ff8==2

name: g_Fsr3OutputColor
description: output-size FSR3 upscaled color

name: g_Fsr3UpscaledDepth
description: output-size depth written by the DebugFSR3CopyUpscaledDepth draw (5fccb795)

name: g_PostChainDepthFsr
description: active post-chain depth (= 0x45c4328 each FSR frame); read by PostEffectApply 0x6db979/0x6df8c1

name: g_Fsr3VelocityFixTarget
description: render-size MV copy target for FSR3VelocityViewportFix (render ratio != 1 only)

name: g_FfxFgCtx
description: FFX frame-generation context; created only when 0x47092b8 exists

name: g_FfxFiSwapchainCtx
description: FFX frame-interpolation swapchain context (FSR FG swapchain backend); null with FG OFF

name: RenderSettings::FsrReactiveMode
description: 2 = generate reactive mask and use it; else no reactive input; copy +0x24c8

name: RenderSettings::FsrAutoExposure
description: 1 = FFX AUTO_EXPOSURE create flag + null exposure resource; copy +0x24d0

name: RenderSettings::FsrEnableSharpening
description: FSR3 dispatch enableSharpening (ACCUMULATE_SHARPEN + RCAS); copy +0x2424

name: RenderSettings::FsrSharpness
description: FSR3 dispatch sharpness; copy +0x2428

name: RenderSettings::FsrDebugView
description: FSR3 dispatch flags bit0 (DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW); copy +0x2533
